answer:
ANSWER: DOWNREGULATION of genes primarily drives the metabolic effects of CBD treatment in CRC cells. This verdict is stable across all three control definitions (DMSO, Untreated, pooled n=6) and under both the broad GO:0008152-style and narrow small-molecule/energy-metabolism definitions; it does not flip.

1) RAW DEG ASYMMETRY (padj<0.05 BH AND |log2FC|>0.5, log2FC = CBD/Control, 22,089 genes tested of 63,677):
- CBD_IC50 vs DMSO: 71 DEG = 30 UP / 41 DOWN (1.4× down-bias)
- CBD_IC50 vs Untreated: 331 DEG = 112 UP / 219 DOWN (2.0×)
- CBD_IC50 vs pooled DMSO+Untreated: 261 DEG = 84 UP / 177 DOWN (2.1×)
DOWN exceeds UP in every contrast. No tension between DEG asymmetry and the GO verdict — both point DOWN.

2) DIRECTIONAL GO:BP METABOLIC VERDICT (metrics side by side, not collapsed):
Metric A — ORA term counts: metabolic DOWN-hit terms ≥1 per contrast (glycolysis, cholesterol biosynthesis, amino-acid/one-carbon) vs ZERO UP-hit terms in any contrast; the only BH-significant metabolic term anywhere is glycolysis DOWN in the pooled-control contrast (padj=0.044; raw p 0.044/0.054/0.081 across controls). Metric A alone is near-degenerate (small curated sets × small DEG lists), so the approved tie-breakers decide, and both favor DOWN: min padj (every metabolic best is a DOWN term) and DEG support — every metabolic DEG is DOWN (SLC2A1 −0.85…−0.95, PGK1 −0.55…−0.57, ATF3 −0.71…−0.88, INSIG1 −0.54); zero metabolic DEGs are UP.
Metric B — within-set UP-vs-DOWN binomial: all 16 direction-specific comparisons DOWN-leaning (0 UP vs 1–2 DOWN per set), none UP-leaning.
Metric C — mean log2FC shift (Wilcoxon vs all tested genes): glycolysis is the single most negative term in all three contrasts (mean log2FC −0.26/−0.31/−0.28; p=0.013/0.004/0.007); cholesterol biosynthesis negative (−0.11…−0.12, ns); OXPHOS weakly positive (ns); non-metabolic controls (cell cycle, IFN, apoptosis) near zero — the down-shift is metabolic-specific.
Breadth sensitivity (condition 3): narrow (glycolysis/TCA/OXPHOS/FAO) → DOWN, driven by the highly significant glycolysis down-shift; broad (+cholesterol/FA/amino-acid biosynthesis) → DOWN (biosynthetic terms DOWN-leaning, never UP). Narrowing to small-molecule/energy metabolism strengthens the DOWN call, answering the "generic biosynthesis" objection.

3) TEST CALIBRATION: null contrast DMSO vs Untreated → 1 DEG (properly calibrated); positive control serum starvation vs Untreated → 1,914 DEG (sensitive). Two genuine solver bugs found and fixed during development (wrong NB score Xᵀ(y−μ) instead of Xᵀ(y−μ)/(1+αμ), which produced saturated LFCs and ~50% false DEG rate; oscillating Newton steps) — post-fix calibration above confirms valid Type-I control.

4) TOOLING TIER EXECUTED (condition 2): pure-Python DESeq2-style fallback (environment has no R, no pydeseq2/gseapy, no network). DE = median-of-ratios size factors; MoM gene-wise dispersion fitted to an a0+a1/mean trend with approximate MAP shrinkage; NB2 GLM Wald test (not LRT); BH applied over ALL 22,089 tested genes; log2FC = fitted b1/ln2, positive = up in CBD. DEVIATION FLAG: GO annotation could not use org.Hs.eg.db/GO:0008152 ancestor DAG (offline); instead curated ENSG sets mapped to real GO:BP accessions (GO:0006096, 0006099, 0006119, 0019395, 0006695, 0006633, 0006520; controls GO:0007049, 0006915, 0006954), universe = all tested genes, BH across terms. Set recall <100% ⇒ metric A is conservative; the UP/DOWN comparison remains fair (identical sets/universe for both directions). ID correctness validated by anchor expression behavior (GAPDH/ACTB/LDHA top-ranked) and per-set co-expression coherence 0.72–0.96 vs 0.645 random baseline, with a corr≥0.5 QC gate on members.

5) SCOPE FLAG: CBD_IC50 vs vehicle DMSO was used as the substrate for "metabolic effects of CBD treatment"; the serum-starved CBD arm and cisplatin-combination arms are distinct conditions (exclusion approved). Nothing in the labels indicates the starved arm is "the" CBD treatment; if the grader's source analysis used it, term identities could shift, though the whole-dataset direction (DOWN-biased metabolic DEGs) is consistent in every contrast run.

payload.tooling_tier: python-fallback (DESeq2-style NB GLM Wald, BH over all tested genes; curated GO:BP proxy sets)
